ls .venv/bin/python .venv/bin/pip install -q pyyaml tail -1 .venv/bin/python - <<'PYEOF'
import yaml, re, glob
bad=0
for f in sorted(glob.glob("06-Audits/*.md")+glob.glob("03-Projects/*.md"))+["00-WORLD.md","TASKS.md","04-Memory/facts.md","02-Methods/incident-fix.md"]:
    t=open(f).read()
    m=re.match(r"^---\n(.*?)\n---",t,re.S)
    if not m: continue
    try: yaml.safe_load(m.group(1))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"{f}: YAML-дефект: {str(e)[:90]}"); bad+=1
print("битых frontmatter:",bad)
PYEOF
